name: comet-card
title: Comet Card
description: A dark portrait card that leans and shifts in 3D under the pointer while a soft white spotlight trails across its surface and the frame lifts slightly.
use: A single featured card such as a portrait, invite or product should feel physical under the pointer.
avoid: Hover-only: touch and keyboard users never get the tilt, and the glare needs a darker card to read well.
a11y: The tilt and glare are pointer-only, and the hover scale ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark card holds a portrait photo of a head against a blue backdrop, with a small mono footer reading 'Comet Invitation' and '#F7RA'. The card floats on black with a heavy soft shadow.
behaves: As the pointer moves over the card it tilts toward the cursor, slides a little the same way, scales up and lifts, while a white radial glare tracks the pointer. Leaving settles it flat.
customise: Wrap any card as children and set rotateDepth, translateDepth and className; the glare size, shadow and hover scale are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One card with a handful of springs driven by pointer movement.
